verdict.rationale: Codex cloud tasks can start from GitHub PRs, GitLab merge requests and issues, Linear issues, or Slack threads, and run in isolated cloud environments that return diffs or PRs. `codex exec` can be called from scripts, CI, and pipelines, so scheduled runs are possible through external CI tooling. The evidence does not show a native always-on agent with built-in scheduling or autonomous maintenance loops. Missing for 10: native schedule/cron-based agents, documented always-on or event-driven autonomous maintenance without a user starting each task, hands-on corroboration of unattended fix workflows.
